data.title: Vehicle tax notice from 2025 (€186 per year)
data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Musterhafen set the motor vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for vehicle MH-BK 510 at €186.00 per year from 1 January 2025. The letter is dated 27 December 2024 and the tax is collected yearly in advance by direct debit.
data.explanation: This is a vehicle tax assessment (Kraftfahrzeugsteuerbescheid) from the customs office. The yearly tax of €186.00 is collected in advance by direct debit, so make sure your account has enough money. If you think the assessment is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the issuing office. The app shows the deadline for this. If you agree, you don't need to do anything. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
